changes.title: Prosecutors move to dismiss Reflecting Pool vandalism case, saying 'botched installation' to blame
changes.summary: The government had accused David Hearn of ripping a piece of sealant after a $14-million renovation. Hearn has repeatedly said that he simply touched the water in the pool out of curiosity last month. (Image credit: Finn Gomez).
